subject.title: fix(msteams): proactive sends fail after conversation migration

question: Should the Microsoft Teams migration accept this complete-invisibility guard as sufficient upgrade proof and land the PR?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and proven, but the final choice intentionally changes when shipped persistent legacy state is archived during upgrade.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the narrow all-zero visibility guard because it prevents destructive archival while preserving canonical runtime state and idempotent existing-row behavior.

options.title: Require broader verification
options.body: Delay landing and require every retained reference to be visible before archival, with a partial-visibility regression test.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow all-zero visibility guard because it prevents destructive archival while preserving canonical runtime state and idempotent existing-row behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current migration and shared state path trace to their recent commit, making them the best available owner for the archive-boundary decision.
